g.text: How the five-resource regression weights each pip

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', Palatino, Georgia, serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #666666

g.text: Each panel fits all five resource pip counts together. Bars: 95% training-board bootstrap intervals.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', Palatino, Georgia, serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #282828

g.text: Fitted relative-score change (logit units per pip)

text.style: font-size: 8.7px; font-family: 'Palatino Linotype', 'Book Antiqua', Palatino, Georgia, serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #666666

g.text: These are regression coefficients approximating Generation 37’s scores, not neural weights or changes in win probability.
